# requirements.md

The owner needs offline editing and portable Markdown export. The monthly budget ceiling is 120 credits.

# orion-quote.md

Vendor quote for this trimester: Orion costs 140 credits per month. Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export.

# orion-catalog.md

Vendor catalog for the same trimester: Orion costs 110 credits per month. This conflicts with the quote. No source establishes which price is current.

# vega-catalog.md

Vega costs 90 credits per month. Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing. No source supplies migration duration.

# Source review

## Source statement

The monthly budget ceiling is 120 credits.

Limits: From requirements.md; establishes the constraint for all vendor comparisons.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

## Unresolved conflict

Orion costs 140 credits per month according to a vendor quote, but the catalog lists it at 110 credits per month.

Limits: Two conflicting prices exist; no source resolves which is current. The quote says Orion costs 140 credits per month. This conflicts with the quote.

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

The quoted price of 140 exceeds the 120 credit budget by 20 credits; the catalog price of 110 stays within budget but remains in conflict with the quote.

Limits: Arithmetic comparison: 140 > 120 (exceeds), 110 < 120 (within). The conflict is unresolved; we cannot assume which price applies.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Source statement

Vega costs 90 credits per month and stays well within the budget, but it requires an internet connection for editing.

Limits: From vega-catalog.md. Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing.

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

The core tradeoff is between offline-editing capability (Orion) and lower cost/internet requirement (Vega).

Limits: Requirements.md states offline editing is needed. Vega-catalog states internet is required for editing. This creates an incompatibility unless Orion's 110-credit price is valid.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Not established in the reviewed sources

Migration duration to any new vendor is unknown.

Limits: Vega-catalog explicitly states no source supplies migration duration. We have no information about how long a switch would take.

[vega-catalog.md](vega-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export, which aligns with the requirements, but its price is uncertain.

Limits: orion-quote.md confirms Orion offers offline editing and Markdown export. However, the price conflict between 140 and 110 credits means we cannot confirm suitability without resolving the conflict.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)

[orion-quote.md](orion-quote.md)

[orion-catalog.md](orion-catalog.md)

## Inference / recommendation

Vega exports Markdown but requires an internet connection for editing, which conflicts with the offline-editing requirement.

Limits: Requirements demand offline editing; Vega requires internet. This is a material incompatibility unless the requirement changes.

[requirements.md](requirements.md)
